title: DevOps Engineer (Hybrid & Multi- Cloud)
description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for a dynamic, growth\-minded DevOps Engineer with 3 to 5 years of experience to bridge the gap between our traditional on\-premises infrastructure and our expanding multi\-cloud footprint (AWS, GCP, and OCI).Here is the honest truth: we don't expect you to be an absolute master of all three clouds and bare\-metal setups on day one. We value your learning trajectory (your slope) over your current baseline knowledge (your intercept). If you have rock\-solid systems fundamentals, a passion for automation, an unstoppable drive to figure things out, and a knack for deep\-dive debugging, you will thrive here.

**Key Responsibilities**

● Hybrid \& Multi\-Cloud Orchestration: Assist in managing, scaling, and maintaining our

on\-premises infrastructure while expanding and supporting environments across AWS,

GCP, and OCI.

● Identity \& Access Management (IAM): Design, implement, and audit secure

authentication and authorization workflows (OIDC, SAML, Cloud IAM, Least Privilege

policies) across hybrid environments.

● CI/CD Pipeline Architecture: Build, maintain, and optimize robust CI/CD pipelines to

ensure safe, repeatable, and rapid code deployments.

● Observability \& Debugging: Set up comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting

systems. You will be the detective who tracks down root causes when complex, distributed

systems misbehave.

● SecOps Integration: Embed security best practices directly into the infrastructure lifecycle

(vulnerability scanning, secrets management, compliance\-as\-code).

**What We Are Looking For**

**Technical Baseline (The Intercept)**

● Experience: 3–5 years in a DevOps, Site Reliability, or Systems Engineering role.

● Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Solid hands\-on experience with Terraform or OpenTofu.

● Operating Systems: Strong Linux administration and networking fundamentals (DNS,

TCP/IP, firewalls, routing) for both cloud and physical hardware.

● Cloud Platforms: Foundational or deep experience in at least one major cloud (AWS,

GCP, or OCI), with a strong conceptual understanding of how to translate those skills to the

others.

● Containers: Experience with Docker and Kubernetes (managed or bare\-metal).

● Tooling Preferences: Familiarity with monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana,

ELK/OpenSearch), CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins), and Secrets

Management (HashiCorp Vault).

Growth Mindset (The Slope)

● Rapid Adaptation: The ability to pick up a completely new cloud provider or tool within

weeks and apply it effectively.

● First\-Principles Thinking: When an application fails, you don't just restart it; you want to

understand why it failed at the OS or network level.

● Automation First: A strong aversion to manual, repetitive tasks; you automate yourself out

of a job wherever possible.
